entry.author: New Zealand Trade and Enterprise
entry.summary:
Prioritising sustainability is no longer a 'nice to have', it's a commercial imperative for New Zealand exporters. Sustainability expert and NZTE Beachhead advisor Becky Lloyed explains how to tackle common global sustainability requirements, and three simple steps to help you get started on your sustainability strategy.

https://my.nzte.govt.nz/article/20251013-get-insights-from-expert-global-business-advisors
